company: Licorne Society (for client, French real-estate-tax SaaS)

evidence.velocity_vs_rigour: Rigueur, autonomie, forte sensibilité business et esprit de synthèse
evidence.velocity_vs_rigour_explanation: The only rigour signal is the soft-skill 'Rigueur' with no testing/governance language, and no velocity/speed language appears either, giving a parity/absence tie resolved as mixed.
evidence.domain_risk: Notre client est un SaaS français leader de la fiscalité immobilière
evidence.domain_risk_explanation: The client is a real-estate tax SaaS which touches financial/tax data but the JD itself gives no explicit compliance or regulatory language, so moderate.
evidence.data_team_maturity: Rattaché(e) directement au Head of Data & Performance
evidence.data_team_maturity_explanation: A named Head of Data & Performance role and an existing tool stack (Snowflake, dbt Cloud, Airbyte, Metabase) indicate a data function that exists and is growing, but the description is thin on team size, so mid rather than mature.
evidence.jd_authorship_explanation: The tech stack section is precise (Snowflake, Airbyte, dbt Cloud, Metabase, GitHub) but the responsibilities bullets themselves were stripped/empty in the source, leaving a mix of precise and generic content typical of a recruiter-mediated posting.
evidence.stakeholder_orientation: rendre la donnée disponible, fiable et actionnable pour l'ensemble des équipes (Marketing, Sales, Finance)
evidence.stakeholder_orientation_explanation: The role serves Marketing, Sales, and Finance stakeholders with no single function dominating, so mixed.
evidence.autonomy_level: un onboarding structuré pour te donner l'ownership complet de la stack data rapidement
evidence.autonomy_level_explanation: The framing emphasizes gaining full ownership of the data stack quickly, a strategic ownership signal.
evidence.ai_role_explanation: No mention of AI tools or AI-consuming infrastructure anywhere in the JD.
evidence.testing_framing: No testing or data quality signal anywhere in the JD.
evidence.testing_framing_explanation: Neither testing tools nor data quality/governance practices are mentioned at all.
evidence.loss_aversion_framing_explanation: None: the JD is framed entirely in terms of data availability, growth, and ownership with no risk or compliance register.
evidence.greenfield_vs_fix_explanation: The JD splits evenly between engineering and BI work with an existing but recently-adopted stack, giving no clear greenfield or fix/scale dominance.
